name: Myth sources (public-domain artwork search)
purpose: Searches museum open-access APIs that need no key (Cleveland Museum of Art, The Met v1.1, Wikimedia Commons) for artworks of myths, gods and heroes and keeps only public-domain or CC0 images. Writes records (url, id, title, creator, date, culture, license, source, institution, attribution) that the collage-design fetcher downloads, validates and credits, for photo plates in mythic-tale films.
capabilities: Licence filtering: CMA share_license_status == CC0; Met isPublicDomain with an image; Commons LicenseShortName public domain or CC0 only
Attribution string per record for on-screen credits and the end card

installation.instructions: Standard library only; python scripts/myth-sources.py search "<query>". Set MOTIONLAB_CONTACT to an e-mail or URL for the User-Agent.

compatibility.notes: Verified live on Windows on 2026-11-23 against all three sources. The Met v1 search was retired on 2026-10-01; the tool uses v1.1 and falls back on 404/410. AIC (Cloudflare), Smithsonian (key) and Openverse (200 requests a day) are not wired.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace tool. Images it finds are public domain or CC0 as stated by the source; a person checks each one before use and the attribution is kept.

security.notes: HTTPS GET to three public APIs, one request at a time with a pause; no credentials. Writes only the --out file.

approval_evidence: Live searches for Krishna, Shiva and Odin on 2026-11-23 returned CC0/public-domain records from all three sources; parsers covered offline by tests/test-mythic.py.
